answer: Copying an answer as a result yields nothing, and producing 147 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the jade ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the pigment review can re-run it. A near-duplicate is rejected at the nectar gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. That is 2 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
